title: fix(pre-merge-readiness): require a rerun before trusting coveredByWaiver
body:
## Background

`pre-merge-readiness.mjs`'s `coveredByWaiver` mechanism (pre-existing,
unchanged by #2021) treats a required check as covered the moment a
valid `idd-external-check-waiver:` marker exists, based purely on the
check's currently-reported live state — it never confirms that the
check has actually been re-run since the waiver became genuinely
active.

For `idd-advisory-convergence` specifically,
`idd-advisory-wait.instructions.md`'s "Terminal routing" section
already documents this gap procedurally: "rerun the existing
`idd-advisory-convergence` run (never `workflow_dispatch`...); both
fields recompute every call, so an expired/invalid marker reverts
automatically." In other words, a maintainer-posted waiver only makes
the real GitHub check-run reflect it once that check is explicitly
re-run — the instructions already assume an agent performs that
re-run as a manual follow-up step.

If a session trusts `pre-merge-readiness.mjs`'s `ready: true` /
`coveredByWaiver: true` output immediately after a valid,
precondition-satisfied waiver is posted, without independently
confirming the check's live run was regenerated since, `gh pr merge`
can still be rejected by GitHub's branch protection: the real
check-run may still carry its pre-waiver `FAILURE` conclusion.

This gap predates #2021 (confirmed present on `main` before that PR)
and applies to the external-check-waiver mechanism in general, not
only `idd-advisory-convergence`. It was explicitly out of scope for
#2021, whose acceptance criteria required existing `coveredByWaiver:
true` behavior stay unchanged once the deadline/terminal precondition
is met. Flagged by a Codex review finding on PR #2033
(kurone-kito/idd-skill#2033) during #2021's own review.

## Proposed change

Have `pre-merge-readiness.mjs` compare each waived check's own
`completedAt` against the moment its waiver became genuinely active
(the waiver comment's `createdAt` for a generic waivable check; also
the deadline/terminal-precondition-open moment for
`idd-advisory-convergence` specifically) before reporting it as
`coveredByWaiver: true`. A check whose live run last completed before
that moment should stay reported as blocked, with evidence naming the
stale run and prompting a re-run, mirroring the existing
`idd-advisory-wait.instructions.md` Terminal-routing guidance instead
of leaving it as an unenforced manual step.

## Acceptance criteria

- `pre-merge-readiness.mjs` reports a waived check as still blocked
  when its live run's `completedAt` predates the moment the waiver
  became genuinely active, even though a valid waiver marker exists.
- A check whose live run already completed after that moment (a
  genuine post-waiver pass, or a pass unrelated to the waiver) is
  unaffected.
- A new test in `tests/pre-merge-readiness.test.mts` covers: a valid,
  precondition-satisfied waiver posted after the check's live run
  last completed (still blocked, evidence names the stale run); the
  same waiver after a fresh run completes (covered).

## Candidate files

- `src/scripts/pre-merge-readiness.mts`
- `src/scripts/protocol-helpers.mts`
- `tests/pre-merge-readiness.test.mts`
- `.github/instructions/idd-pre-merge.instructions.md`

Refs #2021.
